system.description: Warpstone was mixed with dark steel during the forging of this spell's weapon and baleful curses were cast during its construction. As a result, it constantly seeps a corrosive venom that melts away armour and corrupts flesh. Damage Rating: 5 Critical Rating: 2 Group: Ordinary Qualities: Pierce 2 Encumbrance: 3 A Weeping Blade counts as a moderate source of corruption.
